actorId.title: Scraper Actor id
actorId.description: The Actor to repair. Its id names the agent's memory store (shd-agent-memory-<actorId>).

failedRunId.title: Failed run id
failedRunId.description: The failed scraper run. Also the request id of the investigation, so re-running with the same value resumes it.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: `repair` (default) investigates the failed run. `probe` only runs a slow dummy tool to demonstrate abort and resume.
